attachments.insertion_landmark: medial border of scapula, at the root of the spine

actions: retracts and downwardly rotates the scapula

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Smaller and more superior than rhomboid major, sometimes fused with it as a single continuous sheet -- a documented anatomical variant.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler staining, whole-mount nerve arborization mapping
motor_endplate_zones.notes: The medial (origin-side) third, one of two arborization-dense bands. The dorsal scapular nerve enters in the middle third (33-67%), between this zone and the lateral one -- avoid that band, since a documented case of dorsal scapular neuropathy followed an injection placed there.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Yi KH, Lee HJ, Choi YJ, Hu KS, Kim HJ, 'Intramuscular Neural Distribution of Rhomboid Muscles: Evaluation for Botulinum Toxin Injection Using Modified Sihler's Method', Toxins 12(5):289 (2020), doi:10.3390/toxins12050289 -- 30 rhomboid major + 30 minor muscles, 10 of each Sihler-stained, Korean cadavers. Retrieved via PubMed (PMC7291336).

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler staining, whole-mount nerve arborization mapping
motor_endplate_zones.notes: The lateral (insertion-side) third, the second arborization-dense band, mirroring the medial one across the avoided middle third.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Yi KH, Lee HJ, Choi YJ, Hu KS, Kim HJ, 'Intramuscular Neural Distribution of Rhomboid Muscles: Evaluation for Botulinum Toxin Injection Using Modified Sihler's Method', Toxins 12(5):289 (2020), doi:10.3390/toxins12050289 -- 30 rhomboid major + 30 minor muscles, 10 of each Sihler-stained, Korean cadavers. Retrieved via PubMed (PMC7291336).
